Component: NOTE: This is the "combo" hardware variant (v0.2-v1.1) of DumbPad, confirmed via official README.md Bill of Materials section ("No-Encoder" heading). All optional parts from that section are included below.

Notes: 4x4 (16-key) macropad PCB. Eagle .brd/.sch source files in repo; gerbers available for v1.1 (dumbpad_v1.1_gerbers.zip).
4x4 matrix - 16 switches needed. Source from keyboard vendor
CONFIRMED via official BOM: 17 diodes needed (16 keys + 1 extra, likely for the encoder or a spare). DO-35 thru-hole.

Component: Arduino Pro Micro (or pin-compatible ATmega32u4 MCU)
Notes: CONFIRMED via official BOM. Teensy 2.0 is an alternate option for the "combo_teensy" variant - not applicable here since you're building the standard "combo" variant. Source from a keyboard vendor, not Octopart.

CONFIRMED via official BOM: "1x or 2x EC11 rotary encoder with pushbutton (7-pin)" - the PCB supports up to 2 encoders but only 1 is required. Set qty to 2 if you want the second optional encoder position populated.
CONFIRMED via official BOM as optional: "(optional) 1 x 6mm tactile switch (to reset MCU)". Recommended for easier firmware flashing without unplugging.

CONFIRMED via official BOM as optional: "(optional) 3x 3mm resistors (for limiting current in LEDs)". Exact resistance value NOT specified in official BOM - typical current-limiting values for 3mm LEDs at 5V are 220-330 ohm; verify against your chosen LED's forward voltage/current spec before ordering.

NOT explicitly listed as a separate line in the official BOM (only the current-limiting resistors for them are listed), but the PCB is documented elsewhere in the repo as supporting "3 status LEDs" - include 3x 3mm LEDs of your chosen color if populating this optional feature. Only needed if you also add the 3x current-limiting resistors above.
Official combo README does not specify a fixed case design - check repo for any 3D-printable or laser-cut case files, or design/source your own for the 4x4 layout.
Only needed if using a case - exact qty/size depends on chosen case design.
One per EC11 encoder populated (1 or 2, matching the encoder qty above).
